name: 166. Chat reasoning mode pro routes OpenAI through the Responses API (#7580) (chat-reasoning-mode)
description: reasoning.mode (standard | pro) exists only on the OpenAI Responses API for GPT-5.6/GPT-6 (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/reasoning#reasoning-mode). A chat caller sets it inside the reasoning object; Bifrost must serve the request through Responses so pro is not silently downgraded to standard. Red before the fix: raw_request is a chat body with reasoning_effort and no mode. Green after: raw_request is a Responses body with reasoning.mode = pro, and the caller still receives chat.completion / chat.completion.chunk.

item.name: 166.1 openai/gpt-6-luna chat reasoning mode pro unary - chat reasoning mode

exec: var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.test('166.1 exact success status', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + txt).to.equal(200); });
if (pm.response.code !== 200) { return; }
var body = pm.response.json() || {};
pm.test('166.1 caller still gets a chat completion', function () {
pm.expect(body.object, txt.slice(0, 400)).to.eql('chat.completion');
pm.expect(((body.choices || [])[0] || {}).message, txt.slice(0, 400)).to.be.an('object');

pm.expect(body.choices[0].message.content, 'empty assistant content (finish_reason=' + body.choices[0].finish_reason + '; length means the reasoning budget ran out): ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty;
var rr = (body.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
pm.test('166.1 reasoning.mode pro reaches OpenAI on the Responses wire', function () {
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing or unparseable - x-bf-send-back-raw-request not honored: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(rr.input, 'raw_request has no input[]: the chat request was not converted to Responses: ' + JSON.stringify(rr).slice(0, 400)).to.be.an('array');
pm.expect(rr.messages, 'raw_request still carries messages[]: sent to /chat/completions, where mode does not exist').to.be.undefined;
pm.expect(rr.reasoning_effort, 'reasoning_effort is the chat wire spelling; Responses uses reasoning.effort').to.be.undefined;
pm.expect(rr.reasoning, 'reasoning object missing on the wire').to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(rr.reasoning.mode, 'reasoning.mode was dropped before the provider').to.eql('pro');
pm.expect(rr.reasoning.effort).to.eql('low');

item.name: 166.2 openai/gpt-6-luna chat reasoning mode pro streaming - chat reasoning mode

exec: var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.test('166.2 exact success status', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + txt).to.equal(200); });
if (pm.response.code !== 200) { return; }
// extra_fields.raw_response echoes the upstream Responses stream, so the leak check reads the stream without it.

var clientTxt = txt.split('\n').map(function (line) { if (line.indexOf('data:') !== 0) { return line; } var ev; try { ev = JSON.parse(line.slice(5)); } catch (e) { return line; } if (ev && ev.extra_fields) { delete ev.extra_fields.raw_response; } return 'data: ' + JSON.stringify(ev); }).join('\n');
pm.test('166.2 caller still gets a chat completion stream', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('content-type') || '').to.include('event-stream');
pm.expect(txt, txt.slice(0, 400)).to.include('chat.completion.chunk');
pm.expect(txt, 'no [DONE] terminator: ' + txt.slice(-400)).to.include('[DONE]');
pm.expect(clientTxt, 'Responses event names leaked to a chat caller').to.not.include('response.completed');
var rr = null;
var content = '', finish = null;
txt.split('\n').forEach(function (line) {
if (line.indexOf('data:') !== 0) { return; }
var ev; try { ev = JSON.parse(line.slice(5)); } catch (e) { return; }
var raw = ev && ev.extra_fields && ev.extra_fields.raw_request;
if (typeof raw === 'string') { try { raw = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { raw = null; } }
if (raw) { rr = raw; }
var ch = (ev && ev.choices || [])[0] || {};
if (ch.delta && typeof ch.delta.content === 'string') { content += ch.delta.content; }
if (ch.finish_reason) { finish = ch.finish_reason; }
pm.test('166.2 caller receives visible answer text', function () {
pm.expect(content, 'no visible content deltas (finish_reason=' + finish + '; length means the reasoning budget ran out)').to.not.be.empty;
pm.test('166.2 reasoning.mode pro reaches OpenAI on the Responses wire', function () {
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing or unparseable - x-bf-send-back-raw-request not honored: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(rr.input, 'raw_request has no input[]: the chat request was not converted to Responses: ' + JSON.stringify(rr).slice(0, 400)).to.be.an('array');
pm.expect(rr.messages, 'raw_request still carries messages[]: sent to /chat/completions, where mode does not exist').to.be.undefined;
pm.expect(rr.reasoning_effort, 'reasoning_effort is the chat wire spelling; Responses uses reasoning.effort').to.be.undefined;
pm.expect(rr.reasoning, 'reasoning object missing on the wire').to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(rr.reasoning.mode, 'reasoning.mode was dropped before the provider').to.eql('pro');
pm.expect(rr.reasoning.effort).to.eql('low');
